causalFinding.fact: Codex 0.147.0 queues SessionStartSource::Compact after compaction and runs pending SessionStart hooks before the next sampling request, but an existing task rebuilds its Hook runtime only through an application-owned runtime config refresh. Direct external edits to hooks.json and config.toml did not invoke that refresh for this task.

A future route must use an application-owned install or enable lifecycle, or predate measured task execution, without returning setup or recovery to the user.
